name: The Singing Crystals
summary: Kin'weelay seeks a way to free Yenniku from the darkness holding him. He turns to the Mind's Eye and asks you to gather shards that may help him command its power.

sections.title: Echoes of the Mind's Eye
sections.body: Kin'weelay searches old jungle lore for a way to free Yenniku's spirit. The tales speak of the Mind's Eye, a gem hidden deep in Stranglethorn and mighty in magic. Kin'weelay believes it may hold the answer. As he seeks the jungle spirits' guidance to find it, he needs rare catalysts to control its sorcery safely.

sections.title: The Crystalvein Caverns
sections.body: Kin'weelay sends you southeast to Crystalvein Mine, where ironjaw basilisks dwell beneath the earth. He asks you to recover three pulsing blue shards from them. He plans to channel the magic in these singing stones during a final ritual. Once he has recovered the Mind's Eye, he means to bend its power to his will.

aliases: where to start the singing crystals
faq.answer: Kin'weelay, a troll medicine man at Grom'gol Base Camp in Stranglethorn Vale, offers this work.

faq.q: Why are the pulsing blue shards needed?
aliases: why do we need blue shards
faq.answer: Kin'weelay needs the shards' magic to control the Mind's Eye. He hopes to use the powerful jewel to pull Yenniku back from the dark forces holding him.

faq.q: Where can the ironjaw basilisks be found?
faq.answer: Ironjaw basilisks live inside Crystalvein Mine, southeast of Grom'gol Base Camp in the peaks east of the Gurubashi Arena.
The Fate of Yenniku came first and revealed the young troll's dire circumstances.

faq.q: What is Kin'weelay doing while you gather the shards?
faq.answer: Kin'weelay communes with the jungle spirits to find where the Mind's Eye is hidden and learn what protects it.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you aid the Darkspear tribe at Grom'gol Base Camp as they struggle to recover the lost son of their chief.
